semantics.barrier: B=V+lambda*E; E=sum(h*c^T G c). Its finite increment differs from the continuous KKT/dissipation identity and finite-step defect.
semantics.boundary: No new science gate or outcome-filtering; positive barrier increments/finite defects are retained observations.
semantics.cost: Timing comparisons are descriptive cross-server/concurrency comparisons, not hardware-controlled speedup.
semantics.denominator: 6 arms x 10 B100, dynamic 4 arms x40 nodes; output rows are batch/node/layer summaries, not independent request trials.
semantics.history: Within-state history+L2 native work decomposition; not a controlled history-reset experiment.
semantics.l8: All five entry native directions set qN_ref; all five directions rebuilt each node before L8 restriction. 25 builds and 4 L8 JVP per B.
semantics.normalization: Exact source N0=entry residual norm, scale>0, no floor. Frozen within B; not comparable physical coefficient scale across different B or arms.
semantics.physical: Actual materialized FP32 net and step differences; sum of step squared norms is not net squared norm. W0-to-W10 net NOT_RECORDED in publication.
semantics.support: L4–7 actual physical zeros are recorded; missing L4–7 response/H/g in L8 are NOT_RECORDED, not zero.
